verdict.rationale: The official README states that llama.cpp supports 1.5-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit and 8-bit integer quantization for reduced memory use, which spans very-low-bit to 8-bit exactly as the story asks. A community report independently confirms that Q6_K nearly matches FP16 perplexity at much smaller size, letting large models run on constrained hardware. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the quantization workflow and per-format memory figures.
